content: RabbitMQ 4.x (4.0.1 release notes) no longer interprets client-supplied x-death headers on (re)publish; broker still sets/updates x-death on every dead-lettering (expired/rejected/maxlen/delivery_limit). Republish resets counts; apps must track attempts in their own header. Spring AMQP issue #2688 notes Spring Cloud Stream x-death count pattern breaks on 4.0. Official DLX docs: x-death compressed by {queue,reason}; cycle detection drops message if no rejection in the cycle; x-dead-letter-routing-key replaces original routing keys.
